task_description: Add SSL/TLS mutual authentication between agent and server with behavior matching real Puppet (client auth, shared CA, PKI on server side, certificate signing service, auto-signing feature). Update Docker images, Debian packages, Multipass/Vagrant setups. Use OpenSSL (already a dependency), do not use GnuTLS.

patterns.openssl_evp_api: compiler/puppet_stdlib.c lines 4290-4298 - EVP_MD_CTX_new/free pattern for OpenSSL 3.0+ compatibility
patterns.http_handling: server/puppetc_server.c lines 55-93 - MHD request handling (to be replaced)

existing_implementations.description: OpenSSL already used for MD5 hashing (server/puppetc_server.c line 121), EVP API for sha1/md5 (compiler/puppet_stdlib.c). libcurl used for HTTP client (agent/puppetc_agent.c). libmicrohttpd used for HTTP server (server/puppetc_server.c) but only supports GnuTLS for HTTPS.

critical_decisions.http_server_library: Must replace libmicrohttpd with OpenSSL-compatible HTTP server library (libmicrohttpd only supports GnuTLS for HTTPS). Options: libevhtp, libevent, or custom implementation. Recommended: libevhtp for minimal disruption.
critical_decisions.autosign_default: Use policy-based autosigning as recommended default (not naive or basic whitelist)
